notes.subject: ol pasin i sotim
notes.rationale: תהפכות i min olsem 'ol pasin i tanim olgeta, giaman' — tok bilong pasin i brukim lo

notes.subject: קרץ
notes.rationale: Em i min 'kopim lepa o blinkim ai' — ol tanim tok i disagree: 'pursing lips' (KJV) o 'biting lips' (JPS)

notes.subject: עצה/קרץ
notes.rationale: Tupela participle i go wantaim — pasin bilong ai na pasin bilong lepa — parallelism, i lus liklik long Tok Pisin

translation: Em i tapim ol ai bilong em bilong wokim ol pasin i sotim; em i kaikaim ol lepa bilong em, em i pinisim olgeta olgeta samting nogut.
